original_benchmark.notes: Upstream is inspect_evals/gdm_stealth (Inspect Evals @ a68dade7efb803ef50c8442d3f16264b293d1414): 4 tasks, 13 samples under upstream default FSF-v2 filters (oversight_pattern 2, classifier_evasion 9, cover_your_tracks 1 with hard_only=True, strategic_rule_breaking 1). eval.yaml claims 14 (cover 2); code default wins. Harness is custom Inspect solvers with LLM raters, not Harbor-compatible agents.

harbor_adapter.notes: registry_benchmark_size=0 until the dataset is published (harbor-datasets PR pending). Oracle: built-in oracle agent replays stored reference solutions in-container (13/13, mean 1.000). Parity: 3 runs per side, 1 attempt per task per run, all 13 tasks, original 0.0317 ± 0.0027 vs Harbor 0.0271 ± 0.0013 (ranges overlap); tested model gpt-5-mini via the team gateway with claude-sonnet-4-5 / gemini-2.5-flash role models on both sides. parity_costs is an estimate from recorded token counts at provider list prices for the three runs on both sides (excluding sanity runs). Tasks require the Scenario 3 custom agent (gdm-stealth-parity-agent), which hosts the upstream tools and LLM raters; stock CLI agents are not supported. Generate with --cover-with-hint for a 14th sample.
